title: Algerian Dal Malt
description: A comforting Algerian-inspired lentil dish made with the sweetness of malted barley. This hearty dal is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the malted barley, toor dal, and dal to the pan. Stir well.
Add 4 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or parsley.
